title: Пассивный залог во всех временах и с модальными глаголами

why: Пассив (страдательный залог) нужен, когда важно, что произошло с предметом, а не кто это сделал: «Баг исправили», «Сайт был создан в 2020 году». В русском мы часто говорим «исправили», «сказали» без подлежащего, а в английском подлежащее обязательно, поэтому используем пассив.
formation: Формула: to be (в нужном времени) + V3 (третья форма глагола). Меняется только форма to be.
• Present Simple: am/is/are + V3 — The code is checked every day.
• Past Simple: was/were + V3 — The code was checked yesterday.
• Future Simple: will be + V3 — The code will be checked tomorrow.
• Present Continuous: am/is/are being + V3 — The code is being checked now.
• Past Continuous: was/were being + V3 — The code was being checked at five.
• Present Perfect: have/has been + V3 — The code has been checked.
• Past Perfect: had been + V3 — The code had been checked before the release.
• С модальными: modal + be + V3 — The code must be checked. The file can't be opened.
Отрицание: not ставится после первого вспомогательного (is not checked, hasn't been checked). Вопрос: первый вспомогательный выходит вперёд (Was the code checked? Has it been checked?).
usage: 1. Исполнитель неизвестен или неважен: My bike was stolen. (У меня украли велосипед.)
2. Важен результат, а не деятель: The bug has been fixed. (Баг исправлен.)
3. Официальный, научный или технический стиль: Passwords must be changed every 90 days. (Пароли нужно менять каждые 90 дней.)
4. Если исполнитель всё же важен, добавляем by: The app was developed by our team. (Приложение разработала наша команда.)
signalWords: by (кем), yesterday / in 1990 (Past Simple), already / just / yet (Present Perfect), now / at the moment (being), by the time (had been), every day (Present Simple).
mistakes: ✗ The house is building now. → ✓ The house is being built now. (в Continuous нужно being + V3)
✗ My phone was stole. → ✓ My phone was stolen. (после to be только третья форма)
✗ It was happened yesterday. → ✓ It happened yesterday. (глаголы без дополнения — happen, arrive, die, sleep — не имеют пассива)
✗ The tickets have booked. → ✓ The tickets have been booked. (забыли been)
✗ The report must send today. → ✓ The report must be sent today. (после модального нужен be + V3)
remember: Пассив = to be в нужном времени + V3; время меняем только у to be.

items.prompt: The report ___ (send) yesterday.
English ___ (speak) in many countries.
The new app ___ (release) next week.
My laptop ___ (repair) at the moment.
The bug ___ (just / fix).
These photos ___ (take) in Italy last summer.
The office ___ (clean) every evening.
The server ___ (move) to the cloud by the time I joined the team.
The letter (a) wrote (b) was written (c) has written by my boss.
The new bridge (a) is building (b) is being built (c) is build now.
The tickets (a) have been booked (b) have booked (c) are booking already.
This problem (a) can solve (b) can be solved (c) can be solving easily.
The match (a) postponed (b) was postponed (c) was postponing because of the rain.
All passwords (a) must change (b) must be changed (c) must been changed every 90 days.
By Friday the contract (a) will be signed (b) will sign (c) is signing by both sides.
When I arrived, the room (a) was already cleaning (b) had already been cleaned (c) has already been cleaned.
They built this bridge in 1990.
Someone has stolen my bike.
The company will announce the results tomorrow.
items.answer: The results will be announced tomorrow. / The results will be announced by the company tomorrow.

items.prompt: You must not open this file.
items.answer: This file must not be opened.

items.prompt: They are repairing the road.
People speak Spanish in Mexico.
The manager had already signed the documents.
items.answer: The documents had already been signed. / The documents had already been signed by the manager.

items.prompt: We can't finish the project today.
items.answer: The project can't be finished today.

items.prompt: The house is building now.
items.answer: The house is being built now.

items.prompt: My phone was stole yesterday.
The bug has been fix by Anna.
items.answer: The bug has been fixed by Anna.

items.prompt: It was happened last week.
The documents must be send today.
items.answer: The documents must be sent today.

items.prompt: The new office will opened in May.
items.answer: The new office will be opened in May. / The new office will open in May.

items.prompt: She was gave a new laptop.
items.answer: She was given a new laptop.

items.prompt: The cake was ate by the children.
items.answer: The cake was eaten by the children.

items.prompt: Этот сайт был создан в 2020 году.
items.answer: This website was created in 2020. / This site was created in 2020.

items.prompt: Мою машину сейчас ремонтируют.
items.answer: My car is being repaired now. / My car is being fixed now.

items.prompt: Все письма уже отправлены.
items.answer: All the emails have already been sent.

items.prompt: Нам сказали, что встреча отменена.
items.answer: We were told that the meeting was canceled. / We were told that the meeting had been canceled.

items.prompt: Новую функцию выпустят в пятницу.
items.answer: The new feature will be released on Friday.

items.prompt: Этот код нельзя изменять.
items.answer: This code must not be changed. / This code can't be changed.

items.prompt: Меня пригласили на собеседование.
items.answer: I was invited to an interview. / I have been invited to an interview.

items.prompt: Перед релизом было найдено много багов.
items.answer: Many bugs were found before the release.
